Class DensityMap

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.database.DensityMap
@Entity public class DensityMap extends Object
Represents density data for a specific resource in an H3 cell. Stores quantities in gigajoules per kmÂ² for energy-based resources.

Resource categories:

  • Food: Fish, animals, cultivated/wild vegetables
  • Minerals: Copper, iron, gold, rare earths
  • Biomass: Wood, organic matter

Fractal distribution support for realistic clustering (e.g., cities, ore deposits).
